rows.note: Use this for a vitamin, herbal product, or other dietary supplement taken for health or muscle development.

example.english: I take this supplement every day to build muscle.
example.traditional: 我每日都食呢樽營養補充品，希望增肌。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 sik6 ni1 zeon1 jing4 joeng5 bou2 cung1 ban2 hei1 mong6 zang1 gei1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something added to make up for a deficiency.

example.english: The report is too brief, so we need to add a page of information as a supplement.
example.traditional: 份報告太簡略，要加一頁資料作補充。
example.jyutping: fan6 bou3 gou3 taai3 gaan2 loek6 jiu3 gaa1 jat1 jip6 zi1 liu2 zok3 bou2 cung1

rows.note: Use this for an added section of a document or publication containing extra or updated information.

example.english: The new edition has a supplement at the back listing the latest information.
example.traditional: 新版本喺書末加咗附錄，列出最新資料。
example.jyutping: san1 baan2 bun2 hai2 syu1 mut6 gaa1 zo2 fu6 luk6 lit6 ceot1 zeoi3 san1 zi1 liu2
